title: Tattooed Man Double Exposure Snapshot, 1955 B&W Vintage Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from August 1955 depicting a man standing outdoors in front of a mid-century home with stacked stone veneer siding. He wears a fitted white T-shirt and slacks, with visible arm tattoos. An accidental double exposure gives the image a ghostly, layered photographic effect. Printed with 'AUG 55' along the right border.
